Patriots vs Bears DraftKings Showdown Picks: Thursday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Thursday Night Football, October 22 · NFL Week 7 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 22, 10:23 AM ET

Drake Maye has the highest SPAGS projection in the Patriots at Bears DraftKings Showdown: 20.1 points at $10,600 FLEX, 30.2 at captain for $15,900. Across 10,000 simulations Maye holds 69% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Maye is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 6.4 points at a $10,600 FLEX salary, in a game with a 50.5-point total.

Caleb Williams has the largest captain share: 17.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Williams at captain. The model has him running 4.6 times. Drake Maye is the next captain in line, at 16.6%. The model has him running 4.5 times.

Chicago is a 3-point favorite, and the implied totals are 26.75 for the Bears and 23.75 for the Patriots.

Behind Maye and Williams, the next projections are D'Andre Swift (16.8, $9,800), A.J. Brown (14.7, $9,000) and Rhamondre Stevenson (13.3, $7,800).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 22, 10:23 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

TNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Caleb Williams, CHI QB ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

Caleb Williams holds 17.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $15,600 and the 19.8-point SPAGS model projection becomes 29.7 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 4.6 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Williams averaged 19.7 points with a simulated floor of 6.0 and a ceiling of 39.4. He holds 67% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 17.1% as the captain and 50.2% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Drake Maye, NE QB ($10,600 FLEX / $15,900 CPT)

Drake Maye holds 16.6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,900 and the 20.1-point SPAGS model projection becomes 30.2 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 4.5 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Maye averaged 20.0 points with a simulated floor of 6.4 and a ceiling of 41.0. He holds 69% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 16.6% as the captain and 52.0% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: D'Andre Swift, CHI RB ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

D'Andre Swift holds 13.7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,700 and the 16.8-point SPAGS model projection becomes 25.2 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 18.5 carries and 3.0 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Swift averaged 16.7 points with a simulated floor of 6.0 and a ceiling of 34.6. He holds 54% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 13.7% as the captain and 40.2% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Patriots vs Bears

A.J. Brown, NE WR ($9,000 FLEX / $13,500 CPT)

Across 10,000 simulations Brown averaged 14.8 points with a simulated floor of 2.3 and a ceiling of 41.2. He holds 41% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 12.4% as the captain and 28.8% in a FLEX spot.

Rhamondre Stevenson, NE RB ($7,800 FLEX / $11,700 CPT)

Rhamondre Stevenson carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 13.3 DraftKings points for a $7,800 FLEX salary ($11,700 at captain). The model gives him 9.7 carries and 3.3 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Stevenson averaged 13.4 points with a simulated floor of 4.1 and a ceiling of 28.6. Across 10,000 simulations Burden averaged 13.3 points with a simulated floor of 1.0 and a ceiling of 39.2. Colston Loveland, CHI TE ($6,400 FLEX / $9,600 CPT)

Colston Loveland carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 11.7 DraftKings points for a $6,400 FLEX salary ($9,600 at captain). The model gives him 4.8 targets on 22.1 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Loveland averaged 11.6 points with a simulated floor of 3.1 and a ceiling of 26.0. He holds 37% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 5.5% as the captain and 31.8% in a FLEX spot.

Across 10,000 simulations Raymond averaged 7.5 points with a simulated floor of 0.6 and a ceiling of 19.5. He holds 25% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.6% as the captain and 23.6% in a FLEX spot.

Build around Caleb Williams at captain with Drake Maye, Colston Loveland and Rome Odunze at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (19 of 10,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $10,000 for the last two FLEX spots.

Drake Maye leads the SPAGS model at 20.1 DraftKings points for $10,600 at FLEX, or 30.2 points at captain for $15,900.

Drake Maye is the most expensive player at $10,600 FLEX and $15,900 at captain. All 27 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Kalif Raymond (7.6 points at $3,400), Cairo Santos (9.0 points at $5,000) and Andy Borregales (8.5 points at $4,800).

The Bears are a 3-point favorite in a game totaled at 50.5, with implied team totals of 26.75 for the Bears and 23.75 for the Patriots.
